harper: Heads-up: eu-north1 showing elevated preempt churn for ~90m. Small gpu pods repeatedly evicted during reserved job placements, causing pipeline jitter.
leo: saw the spike. Scheduler logs: lots of fit_failures followed by preempt attempts. Heterogeneous GPU sizes + strict pack threshold.
nida: Any quick wins? Customers complaining about tail queue time.
harper: Short-term: 1) increase warm-pool in eu-north1 by +25% for 1h, 2) add a temporary toleration for low-priority namespaces, 3) canary a scheduler tweak to reduce repack aggressiveness.
leo: sample ops: 
```bash
# scale warm-pool
kubectl -n infra-scale scale deploy/warm-pool-eun --replicas=50 # from 40
# add toleration to spot-ns only
kubectl -n spot-batch patch deployment --all -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"tolerations":[{"key":"gpu_frag_help","operator":"Exists","effect":"NoSchedule","tolerationSeconds":3600}]}}}}'
# canary scheduler patch (dry-run first)
kubectl -n kube-system patch configmap gpu-scheduler-config --type merge -p '{"data":{"eagerRepack":""}}' --dry-run=server
```
nida: good. Also propose labeling a small set of nodes as "frag-friendly" and add a lightweight scoring bonus so tiny pods prefer those nodes instead of triggering global repacks.
harper: agree. We'll do a canary in eu-north1a only. infra-bot, create runbook and hook fit_failures, preempt_rate, pod_start_latency.
infra-bot: [runbook] id=r-eun-09 owner=leo cohort=eu-north1a duration=30m.
leo: applying warm-pool scale and toleration now. Can start node labeling after warmpool stabilizes.
infra-bot: [info] warm-pool scale requested by leo. req=r-cc7.
harper: after scale, apply frag-friendly label to 4 nodes and canary scheduler scoring to 10% of schedulers. Keep changes for 30m and evaluate. If preempt_rate drops >20% and reserved tail unaffected, extend to 1h.
leo: labels applied: gpu-eun-01..04 frag-friendly=true. Can apply configmap canary to 10% now.
infra-bot: [metric] 10m telemetry: preempt_rate -13%, fit_failures -17%, pod_start_p50 -41s.
nida: early signs look good. Cost note: warm-pool +25% is ~ $900/day if fully active. We'll keep the window minimal.
harper: follow-ups: 1) collect allocation traces (leo) 2) test tame-eagerRepack flag in staging (nida) 3) RFC for adaptive-fragment-heuristic (harper).
leo: if improvement holds at 30m, we'll extend canary to 50% and keep warm-pool +20% for 2h.
infra-bot: [alert] runbook r-eun-09 active. Auto-expire in 30m.
harper: thumbs up. Revert quickly if reserved-job latency regresses. :eyes:
